MP0001.name: Visually similar distractors and short gaps are merged into overly broad boundaries
MP0001.canonical_question: How can MR model semantic and temporal relationships among multiple correct answer segments?
MP0001.root_cause: The training unit is an isolated fixed-length snippet rather than a set or pair of answer clips.
MP0001.failure_mode: Independent snippet scoring cannot represent global relationships among multiple answer segments.

MP0002.macro_problem_name: Boundary Structure and Temporal Precision and Semantic Negative Construction and Distractor Control
MP0002.name: Temporal boundary representations change under diversified surrounding context
MP0002.canonical_question: How can boundary features remain semantically stable when the surrounding temporal context changes?
MP0002.root_cause: Precise localization depends on local boundary evidence as well as surrounding temporal context.
MP0002.failure_mode: Boundary clips become hard negatives or shift representation when context is replaced.

representative_papers.title: CVA: Context-aware Video-text Alignment for Video Temporal Grounding

evidence.quote: Second, we introduce the Context-invariant Boundary Discrimination (CBD) loss, a contrastive loss that enforces semantic consistency at challenging temporal boundaries, making their representations robust to contextual shifts and hard negatives.

MP0003.macro_problem_name: Evidence Sufficiency, Uncertainty, and Abstention and Shortcut Bias and Spurious Context Dependence
MP0003.name: Vanilla DER miscalibrates uncertainty under multimodal evidence fusion
MP0003.canonical_question: How can DER be adapted when evidence must be fused from video and text?
MP0003.root_cause: Vanilla DER relies on a heuristic regularizer and does not account for visual-text modality imbalance.
MP0003.failure_mode: Higher-error predictions may receive lower uncertainty while accurate samples receive higher uncertainty.

representative_papers.title: Adaptive Evidential Learning for Temporal-Semantic Robustness in Moment Retrieval

evidence.quote: Additionally, DER faces counterintuitive uncertainty issues: higher-error predictions can receive lower uncertainty due to limitations in vanilla DER’s regularizer.

member_units.name: Vanilla DER miscalibrates uncertainty under multimodal evidence fusion

MP0004.macro_problem_name: Evidence Sufficiency, Uncertainty, and Abstention and Shortcut Bias and Spurious Context Dependence
MP0004.name: End-to-end VLM adaptation on long raw videos is computationally impractical
MP0004.canonical_question: How can a VLM image encoder be adapted in-domain before downstream grounding without end-to-end long-video training?
MP0004.root_cause: The adaptation target is a large pretrained image encoder while the downstream input is long video.
MP0004.failure_mode: Jointly training the feature encoder and downstream model on long raw videos incurs prohibitive cost.

representative_papers.title: ActPrompt: In-Domain Feature Adaptation via Action Cues for Video Temporal Grounding

evidence.quote: Firstly, trivial end-to-end fine-tuning is impractical because it requires training the feature encoder and the downstream model concurrently on long raw videos, resulting in extremely high computational overhead.

member_units.name: End-to-end VLM adaptation on long raw videos is computationally impractical

MP0005.macro_problem_name: Boundary Structure and Temporal Precision and Semantic Negative Construction and Distractor Control
MP0005.name: Query-agnostic content mixing creates semantically false negatives
MP0005.canonical_question: How can context diversification avoid replacing backgrounds with clips that remain relevant to the query?
MP0005.root_cause: The augmentation samples replacement clips without measuring video-text relevance.
MP0005.failure_mode: Semantically related replacement clips are treated as negatives and provide contradictory supervision.

representative_papers.title: CVA: Context-aware Video-text Alignment for Video Temporal Grounding

evidence.quote: It builds a video-text similarity-based pool of replacement clips to simulate diverse contexts while preventing the false negative caused by query-agnostic mixing.

MP0006.macro_problem_name: Evidence Sufficiency, Uncertainty, and Abstention and Shortcut Bias and Spurious Context Dependence
MP0006.name: NMS-based deterministic inference forces hard segment selection under missing visual evidence
MP0006.canonical_question: How can MR avoid overconfident temporal selection when query-required evidence is missing or incomplete?
MP0006.root_cause: Deterministic MR cannot represent evidence insufficiency or abstain on hard moments.
MP0006.failure_mode: NMS still selects the most probable segment although the model lacks evidence for the queried action.

MP0007.macro_problem_name: Boundary Structure and Temporal Precision and Semantic Negative Construction and Distractor Control
MP0007.name: Image-pretrained VLMs miss action-sensitive objects
MP0007.canonical_question: How can image-pretrained VLMs distinguish action-sensitive objects from static background objects?
MP0007.root_cause: Image-text pretraining lacks temporal action cues and creates a domain gap with video grounding.
MP0007.failure_mode: The image encoder attends to static object semantics and overlooks objects involved in motion or action.

representative_papers.title: ActPrompt: In-Domain Feature Adaptation via Action Cues for Video Temporal Grounding

evidence.quote: However, being pre-trained on massive image-text data, VLM tend to focus on the semantics of static objects.
